title: [US]Expand to All 3 Partner Services to Unlock Tier Growth & Benefits
breadcrumb: [US]Expand to All 3 Partner Services to Unlock Tier Growth & Benefits
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2025-07-18
html:
Dear Partner, We encourage you to expand and activate all three partner service categories in Partner Center: Creator Matchmaking, Seller Service, and Creator Service. Doing so allows you to unlock more collaboration opportunities and can help you grow your business more effectively.

By offering more comprehensive services, you not only provide end-to-end support to sellers and creators but also improve the chances of reaching a higher TSP Tier. Partners offering a single service have their final score calculated with a 90% service weight, while those offering multiple services benefit from an average score across services, multiplied by a higher weight of 110% to 130%. This increased weight gives multi-service partners a stronger advantage in tier evaluation, unlocking higher ranking, operational protection, marketing support, and more collaboration opportunities. *For more details on tier calculation and benefits, please refer to the information provided here: https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/68411b45314d2504a1a7c407

To activate new service categories: Go to Partner Center > My Account > Service Category and register the services you'd like to provide. If you have any questions, feel free to raise a ticket through Partner Center > Tickets.
